description_en: Company announcements to display at startup (one will be randomly selected if multiple are provided)
description_ja: 起動時に表示する会社からのお知らせを設定します。複数ある場合はランダムに1つが表示されます。
use_case_ja: - 組織の管理者が、社内のコーディング規約の参照やセキュリティポリシーの周知など、ツール利用開始時に重要なメッセージを開発者へ伝えたい場合に使用します。
doc_snippets: }, "companyAnnouncements": [ "Welcome to Acme Corp! Review our code guidelines at docs.acme.com", "Reminder: Code reviews required for all PRs", "New security policy in effect"

| blockedMarketplaces | (Managed settings only) Blocklist of marketplace sources. Enforced on marketplace add and on plugin install, update, refresh, and auto-update, so a marketplace added before the policy was set cannot be used to fetch plugins. Blocked sources are checked before downloading, so they never touch the filesystem. See Managed marketplace restrictions | [{ "source": "github", "repo": "untrusted/plugins" }] | | channelsEnabled | (Managed settings only) Allow channels for the organization. On claude.ai Team and Enterprise plans, channels are blocked when this is unset or false . For Anthropic Console accounts using API key authentication, channels are allowed by default unless your organization deploys managed settings, in which case this key must be set to true | true | | cleanupPeriodDays | Session files older than this period are deleted at startup (default: 30 days, minimum 1). Setting to 0 is rejected with a validation error. Also controls the age cutoff for automatic removal of orphaned subagent worktrees at startup. To disable transcript writes entirely, set the CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY environment variable, or in non-interactive mode ( -p ) use the --no-session-persistence flag or the persistSession: false SDK option. | 20 | | companyAnnouncements | Announcement to display to users at startup. If multiple announcements are provided, they will be cycled through at random. | ["Welcome to Acme Corp! Review our code guidelines at docs.acme.com"] | | defaultShell | Default shell for input-box ! commands. Accepts "bash" (default) or "powershell" . Setting "powershell" routes interactive ! commands through PowerShell on Windows. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL=1 . See PowerShell tool | "powershell" | | deniedMcpServers | When set in managed-settings.json, denylist of MCP servers that are explicitly blocked. Applies to all scopes including managed servers. Denylist takes precedence over allowlist. See Managed MCP configuration | [{ "serverName": "filesystem" }] | | disableAllHooks | Disable all hooks and any custom status line | true |
